financings_after_balance_sheet.what: October 2025 underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants (gross proceeds; net not given)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On October 2, 2025, the Company completed an underwritten offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants to purchase common stock for gross proceeds of $138.0 million

warrants.quote: into an aggregate of up to 8,637,810 shares of our common stock, at an exercise price of $0.9047 per share, and a term of exercise equal to five years from the date of Warrant Stockholder Approval.
